title: mimi-server: Room/create checks and bound Chat restrictions
description: Room/create: the seven checks and a bound Chat (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 L272-284); roomId Chat restrictions (L251, L424-426) via the dfo4 hook.
